comparison.objective: Seat a bracket bolt using a ratchet within confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Socket engagement and repeated short ratchet strokes under spatial constraints.
comparison.success_condition: Actual bolt-head/bracket contact with thread integrity, continuously held 0.5 s. Torque and cycle count are diagnostic only; explicit tool-release criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests threaded fastening and confined tool use, not selective aperture passage.
